summary: A Readymag page for Nouvelle Noire's re-released Clarendon-style slab NN Colroy. Every block is a rounded sticker shape in loud green, yellow, pink and violet: a sticker-board hero, colour-banded weight strips, a big variable 'm', a yellow glyph sheet, a language card, cropped-glyph detail tiles, paragraph cards waterfalling through the weights, and a 'Never Mind the Sans Serif → GOOD BUY' finale. A fixed bottom row of black pills (Buy, Specimen PDF, Trials, Request variable fonts) stays on screen throughout.

instances.ux: static; the fixed bottom pill bar is already visible
instances.learn: Announce the news (new weights) as a sticker in which the two ends of the range are set in those weights ('Thin → Black')
